_comment: Windows 95 release of Lemmings (Lemmings Paintball era port).
long: Lemmings 95 is the Windows release of the classic puzzle game, tasking players with guiding herds of lemmings to safety. Players assign skills like digging, climbing and bridge-building to navigate each level's traps and obstacles within a limited budget of abilities. It packages the original Lemmings levels for Windows 95 systems.
